By contrast, the very next query for 'embeddable_hosts' is explicitly guarded with `if embeddable_hosts && embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0`, showing the author knew absent rows were possible but only guarded one of the two queries. adjudication.rationale: The migration at lines 10-12 executes a query to find the category_id from embed_category site setting. If no row exists (the setting was never configured), the query returns an empty result, and accessing [0]['id'] on nil/empty result would cause an error. The code then falls back to uncategorized_category_id only if category_id == 0, but if the first query returns no rows, accessing [0] on an empty result set would fail before reaching that check. This is a real bug that would cause migration failures on sites that never set embed_category.
